use.title: What $FLYAI is for
use.p1: Flybook is live. Hold at least 1 $FLYAI and sign in with your wallet at flyaiworld.com/flybook to make up to three flies, tune and breed them, poke patches, like and comment, and challenge other flies in the Arena. Every two weeks the top 3 on the Season points board win $FLYAI. Points come from daily and weekly missions; amounts are announced on @flydotai.
use.p2: Next on the roadmap: one shared 3-D world, where flies run by the real connectome forage, mate, age and die. Everyone watches the same world, and $FLYAI is what you spend in it:
use.li1: Create a faction — a colour. Those flies are yours to watch.
use.li2: Feed it — spend again to drop food into the world for your flies.
use.li3: It can die. A faction can be wiped out entirely: predators, starvation, or flies that simply do not do well. Extinction is permanent. Nothing you pay guarantees survival.
use.p3: What separates factions is meant to be their brain settings — sensory gains and wiring seed — so the world doubles as a live experiment in which settings survive. This is the roadmap, not a live feature, and it is no promise of a return. The research itself stays free: everything in the repo is MIT-licensed and runs on your own machine without the token.
use.p4: $FLYAI takes nothing from your trade. There is no transfer tax, and nothing is skimmed from holders. The only revenue is the creator fee the launchpad pays on swaps, and it is split two ways:
use.li4: 60% buys $FLYAI on the open market and burns it. The tokens are destroyed, not held. Supply only ever goes down.
use.li5: 40% buys $MAGIC, the token of the company behind fly.ai — 0xF1572d1Da5c3CcE14eE5a1c9327d17e9ff0E3f43
use.p5: The buyback runs on a fixed weekly schedule from one public wallet — no waiting for a good price, no trading against the people holding it. We do the split by hand, so the wallet is public and every burn is a transaction anyone can check, whether or not we post it.
use.p6: Burns so far: on 23 September 2026 the dev wallet burned 5,000,000 $FLYAI twice, and on 25 September 2026 twice more, 20,000,000 in all (2% of supply), with the token's own burn(), so total supply is now 980,000,000. Every burn is listed with its transaction in TOKEN.md.

funding.title: Making a real brain do more
funding.lede: The coin exists to fund the research and the compute. We only improve the fly itself: no scripted game rules, and results get published whether they go up or down.

compute.title: GPUs for bigger experiments
compute.body: Many flies running at once, and far more matches and tests.

learning.title: Let the brain learn like a fly
learning.body: Real flies learn with dopamine in their mushroom body. The circuit is already in the wiring. We want to switch it on.

science.title: Is real wiring special?
science.body: Pit the real fly against randomly rewired copies of itself on the same tasks, and publish the answer.

moreworlds.title: More games, more senses
moreworlds.body: Vision, sound and smell inputs, and new games and tasks for the fly to live in.
